phone.title: Choose, switch and recover acknowledged research
phone.description: Four saved commanders submit real research orders through keyboard controls. Receipts bind original payloads and effective ticks. Reload recovers accepted authority; a second device holds its original command while another order makes its revision stale for rejection. The guarded demo clock changes only designated domain time. Labelled leased tick delivery verifies completion, retained overflow and the following-tick Innovation effect; hosted scheduling and proposed rules remain unapproved.

steps.description: Set the designated browser/domain clock to12:15 UTC and deliver the real Scheduler HTTP request. Authentication remains real. This is not hosted scheduling certification.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open both private science instruments and choose investing by keyboard without sending.
steps.acknowledgement: Investing is a local choice; no command or receipt exists.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Close with Escape and reopen; unsent investing survives within the campaign.
steps.acknowledgement: The investing radio is restored without a command.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Read investing cost and effect before the first production ledger exists, without sending a command.
steps.acknowledgement: The forecast opens with keyboard focus and matches the authoritative private projection.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.
Cost and next effect are exact; unknown rate or queued switch suppresses ETA, and the full forecast fits above the panel footer.

steps.description: Scroll the bounded forecast with the keyboard while the actual Queue control stays fully visible.
steps.acknowledgement: The focused forecast reveals its active-target qualification without sending another command.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.
Active navigation and Queue investing are contained above the fixed footer.

steps.description: Commit investing and wait for its genuine authoritative receipt.
steps.acknowledgement: The accepted receipt binds the original payload; investing is scheduled for tick1 while navigation remains active.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Read the forecast after the server has accepted the original investing order; active navigation remains distinct.
steps.acknowledgement: The forecast opens with keyboard focus and matches the authoritative private projection.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.
Cost and next effect are exact; unknown rate or queued switch suppresses ETA, and the full forecast fits above the panel footer.

steps.description: Scroll the bounded forecast with the keyboard while the actual Queue control stays fully visible.
steps.acknowledgement: The focused forecast reveals its active-target qualification without sending another command.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.
Active navigation and Queue investing are contained above the fixed footer.

steps.description: Reload and recover the accepted investing order from authority.
steps.acknowledgement: The same UUID and tick recover; reload creates no extra receipt.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Ordinary sign-in on a second device uses the same saved identity without resaving it; no campaign command is injected.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Harness fault: hold only original research ingress frames. Authentication/key requests and private-view updates remain real; no payload is rewritten.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Submit recruiting from the second device's current revision. Waiting is not acceptance.
steps.acknowledgement: The second device waits; authority still has only the first accepted order.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Reload while the original recruiting command is withheld. Recover its exact submitted target and acknowledgement panel; this is durable submitted intent, not an unsent draft.
steps.acknowledgement: The authenticated outbox restores recruiting and reopens Economy while the original command is still unacknowledged.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.
The entire restored Recruiting control is contained inside the keyboard-focused bounded list and Economy reading viewport after End and any required ArrowUp reading scroll settles.
The selected control remains fully contained at the recovered-choice capture boundary.

steps.description: Use the next keyboard reading position to find the original command's pending acknowledgement and Retry remedy. Reading does not retry or submit another command.
steps.acknowledgement: The same submitted command remains durable and unacknowledged; both pending and Retry controls are readable.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.
Retry is keyboard-focused and fully contained along with the pending control immediately before capture.

steps.description: Use normal motion on the current device; outcome assertions remain identical and captures wait for finite motion.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Commit innovation while the second device has an unacknowledged original command.
steps.acknowledgement: Two distinct accepted orders preserve sequence, first order and progress before settlement.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Release the exact held frames after the competing order is accepted. No synthesized request, extra write or rewritten payload.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Read the authoritative conflict and retain recruiting for review.
steps.acknowledgement: One rejected conflict receipt leaves the two accepted orders intact and preserves the local choice.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Close Economy with Escape; the same research conflict remains discoverable on the galaxy.
steps.acknowledgement: Exactly one accessible route error replaces the panel error; Economy regains keyboard focus.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Reopen Economy and review the preserved recruiting choice with a single in-panel remedy.
steps.acknowledgement: Panel ownership returns without duplicating the error or sending another command.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: After rejection, deliberately choose the currently acknowledged Innovation target without sending. Later views must not restore the rejected Recruiting choice.
steps.acknowledgement: Only local intent changes; the original rejected receipt and two accepted orders remain authoritative.
verifications: Research admissions leave resources, levels, progress and the peer's private science unchanged; owner order IDs are absent from serialized peer views.

steps.description: Advance only the existing demo domain clock and call the real leased settlement service. Competing and repeated delivery must settle each due tick once. No research levels, resources, receipts or private views are injected; this is not hosted Scheduler certification.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Reload both commanders and read the actual retained science one funded tick before Innovation completes.
steps.acknowledgement: Reload recovers the actual settled tick and the original applied order; production creates no additional command receipt.
verifications: Exact completion/overflow and next-tick rate match the authorized projection; the peer receives no owner order IDs or Innovation benefit.
Both players can read their complete science ledger and progress after keyboard navigation inside the bounded Economy panel.

steps.description: Advance only the existing demo domain clock and call the real leased settlement service. Competing and repeated delivery must settle each due tick once. No research levels, resources, receipts or private views are injected; this is not hosted Scheduler certification.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Reload the completed Innovation level: its cost is spent once, excess science remains, and this tick used the old production rate.
steps.acknowledgement: Reload recovers the actual settled tick and the original applied order; production creates no additional command receipt.
verifications: Exact completion/overflow and next-tick rate match the authorized projection; the peer receives no owner order IDs or Innovation benefit.
Both players can read their complete science ledger and progress after keyboard navigation inside the bounded Economy panel.

steps.description: Advance only the existing demo domain clock and call the real leased settlement service. Competing and repeated delivery must settle each due tick once. No research levels, resources, receipts or private views are injected; this is not hosted Scheduler certification.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Reload the next confirmed tick: Innovation now raises science output while the other commander's navigation remains private and independent.
steps.acknowledgement: Reload recovers the actual settled tick and the original applied order; production creates no additional command receipt.
verifications: Exact completion/overflow and next-tick rate match the authorized projection; the peer receives no owner order IDs or Innovation benefit.
Both players can read their complete science ledger and progress after keyboard navigation inside the bounded Economy panel.

steps.description: Read the same device after real tick updates. Innovation remains selected; no old Recruiting command is reapplied or silently resubmitted.
steps.acknowledgement: The latest authorized level1 projection retains the newer local choice and the exact original receipts.
verifications: The newer local choice leaves saved identity and the independent peer's science unchanged.

short.title: Choose, switch and recover acknowledged research
short.description: Four saved commanders submit real research orders through keyboard controls. Receipts bind original payloads and effective ticks. Reload recovers accepted authority; a second device holds its original command while another order makes its revision stale for rejection. The guarded demo clock changes only designated domain time. Labelled leased tick delivery verifies completion, retained overflow and the following-tick Innovation effect; hosted scheduling and proposed rules remain unapproved.
